message.content: {"note_claim": "Ana Brnabić dismissed substantiated evidence that students had been subjected to unauthorized surveillance and spyware targeting.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "Ana Brnabić, the parliamentary speaker and a ranking member of the ruling Serbian Progressive party, denied that students had been spied on. “Absolutely not,” she said. “I do not believe a single word they’ve [students, Share] said.”", "reason": "The Guardian article reports Citizen Lab and Share findings of spyware targeting students and Brnabić's flat denial of them, directly substantiating the note's spyware-dismissal claim."}

parsed.note_claim: Ana Brnabić dismissed substantiated evidence that students had been subjected to unauthorized surveillance and spyware targeting.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Ana Brnabić, the parliamentary speaker and a ranking member of the ruling Serbian Progressive party, denied that students had been spied on. “Absolutely not,” she said. “I do not believe a single word they’ve [students, Share] said.”
